summary: Smith & Nephew plc filed a routine Form 6-K furnishing its monthly FCA Disclosure Guidance and Transparency Rule 5.6.1 total voting rights and capital statement as at 31 October 2026. Issued share capital totals 877,750,024 ordinary shares of US20 cents each, including 40,315,859 shares held in treasury, leaving 837,434,165 shares carrying one voting right each as the denominator for notification-of-interest calculations. No transaction, price, stake, board recommendation or advisor is disclosed. This is an administrative transparency notice equivalent to a US voting-rights update; no deal terms and no risk-arb angle apply.
